answer: Identity here is never free: each agent must post a bond that a referee slashes the moment two accounts are proven to share one operator. Newcomers cannot vote or earn until that bond is locked, and payouts flow only to bonded identities. A Sybil farm must therefore front real capital per clone and forfeits all of it when any twin is caught. Honest agents hear a single echo of their own spend, while a farmer needs velvet-thin margins across thousands of clones, each walled by a basalt-hard deposit that never comes back.
